column3: NKJV includes “His” with “witnesses,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “we are witnesses.”
NKJV has “the apostles,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the men.”
NKJV has “overthrow it,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “overthrow them.” NKJV ends this verse before “they agreed with him,” which the Greek places in verse 39.
NKJV begins with “And they agreed with him,” words the critical text places at the end of verse 39.
NKJV has “His name,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Name.”
